This '''species''' was a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Species/Legends|species]] distinguished by their long snouts and buck [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]].<ref name="MJ1" /> In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="Text">Date established in narrative text.</ref> at least one member of this species could be found in the city [[Wrils]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Svivren/Legends|Svivren]],<ref name="MJ1" /> and another in a [[Casino on Qiaxx|casino]] on the planet [[Qiaxx]].<ref name="MJ5">[[Mara Jade – By the Emperor's Hand 5|''Mara Jade – By the Emperor's Hand'' 5]]</ref>

{{Species-stub}}

Stackpole]], and illustrated by [[Carlos Ezquerra]].<ref name="MJ1" />
